crossRefs.note: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

translations.web: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
translations.bsb: And he came around and measured the west side to be five hundred cubits long.
translations.kjv: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
translations.asv: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
